Short Press Bio

A premium performance identity with commercial clarity.

The Performa is the live electronic performance identity of Atlanta artist Chip Lee. Blending electronic music, live instrumentation, choreography, and interactive stage presence, The Performa delivers a high-energy performance experience designed to move audiences both physically and emotionally. Built to connect across cultures and audiences, the show combines global musical influences with modern performance technology to create a dynamic environment where the artist and audience move together. The Performa is not just music. It is movement, rhythm, culture, and connection.

Artist Narrative

Chip Lee built thePerforma around a simple belief: music should bring people together.

Across cultures, languages, and backgrounds, rhythm is one of the most universal forms of communication. The Performa reflects that idea by blending sounds, movements, and influences from multiple musical traditions into a performance that feels welcoming, celebratory, and alive.

The experience is designed as a multi-dimensional live performance where music, movement, live instrumentation, audience interaction, and technology work together on the same stage. Electronic and global rhythms move between cultures, tempos, and moods while live musicians add improvisation, texture, and organic energy.

Whether the room is a nightclub, festival stage, private event, or cultural gathering, the goal is the same: create an atmosphere where everyone in the room feels part of the moment. The Performa thrives on shared energy between performer and audience, turning spectators into participants.
